title: Time-travelling Nordic humans manipulating history

tellings.quote: continuity. We are dealing with people who achieved time travel at some point.

plain: Some of the beings in UFO encounters are said to be tall, fair, human-looking 'Nordics' who are really humans from the future, around 2050, who have mastered time travel and are steering history across Earth, the Moon and Mars. The philosopher Jason Jorjani lays this out on the show, drawing on a book he cites, Closer Encounters, and saying 'we are dealing with people who achieved time travel at some point'. If true, the visitors would not be aliens at all but our own descendants.
